reviews.comment: I took him in the 2024 fall semester (my sophomore year), and he might be my favorite professor ever. Statics and Dynamics is a challenging class, and Mr. Sorensen made it a pretty easy class. He graded very, very lightly and gave a lot of partial credit. There is a decent amount of homework, and his office hours are very helpful. He's the goat.
reviews.ratingTags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Professor Sorensen was a great professor, but his course did not feel challenging enough. Even though I learned a lot, it felt that the grading seemed too nice. The homework's were well set up, as they offered a detailed well explained solution if you got stuck. The tests seemed too straightforward, and not challenging enough. Overall, good prof.

very good professor!! i got a high A in the class, but make sure you thoroughly understand the homework and quizzes he gives you. he gives a lot of extra credit if you are there in class, so make sure to be in person as much as possible. make sure to read the textbook for better understanding of concepts as lectures might go a little fast sometimes

Incredible professor made Statics and Dynamics an understandable course and was able to teach the fundamentals from scratch and leave us with a knowledgeable understanding in order to apply the concepts later on into the degree plan.

Even though this is a new and accelerated class, Dr. Sorensen did a fantastic job. He taught the class well and actively sought ways to improve it. You don't have to go to class, but he tries to help those who do by giving extra credit. Homework takes a while, so set aside time to get it done, but there are plenty of resources to check answers.
reviews.ratingTags: EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework
